title: 列車制動熱負載管理
summary: 以能量分配與耐久兩條路徑檢查長坡或連續停站的熱負荷，保留冷卻間隔。
summaryEn: Use energy-sharing and durability paths to examine sustained-grade or repeated-stop heat loads, retaining cooling intervals.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創汽車與交通工具教學。所有數值均為明示假設，不是同名車輛的實測規格、認證或維修設定。使用試算表、紙面圖、合成資料及自行準備的離線模型；不提供真實高壓、道路、壓力設備或控制器操作授權。
scopeEn: Original automotive teaching based on public principles. All numerical inputs are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vehicle specifications, certification criteria or maintenance settings. Use worksheets, paper diagrams, synthetic data and offline models you prepare; no authorization for real high-voltage, road, pressure-equipment or controller operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 動能與吸能行程：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Kinetic energy and crush stroke: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 動能與吸能行程 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Kinetic energy and crush stroke and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 本課觀察對象為制動盤、再生路徑與冷卻流。撞擊前平動動能是整車能量尺度；乘員約束與侵入不能由單一能量值判定。
steps.instructionEn: This course follows brake discs, regenerative path and cooling flow. Pre-impact translational energy sets the vehicle energy scale; occupant restraint and intrusion cannot be judged by one energy value.
steps.observation: 獨立教學工況，非原廠或實測規格；跨單元整合須先統一輸入及分配邊界：水平道路、減速到靜止：E=.5 m v²；m=40000 kg、v=25 m/s；計算結果=12500 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Independent teaching operating point, not OEM or measured specifications; reconcile inputs and allocation boundaries before cross-unit integration: Level-road stop: E=.5 m v²; m=40000 kg, v=25 m/s; result=12500 kJ.
steps.failure: 只比較峰值加速度會忽略脈衝時間和侵入；同時看時間歷程與艙體變形。
steps.failureEn: Peak acceleration alone misses pulse duration and intrusion; inspect the full trace and cell deformation.
steps.check: 總動能12500 kJ；本課回生及制動盤熱量使用同一質量與初速。 將此判讀連回制動盤、再生路徑與冷卻流的資料，記錄量測位置、邊界與資料版本。
steps.checkEn: Total kinetic energy is 12500 kJ; the regeneration and brake-disc examples share this mass and speed. Relate this interpretation to brake discs, regenerative path and cooling flow and record measurement locations, boundaries and data version.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
